raw_response:
I’m old now, so I don’t chase fancy things. On 10.5 mu, with just two people in the house, I do what I know I can finish on time and still sleep at night. Wheat is still important because it is steady, and after wheat I put millet on that land because millet is more saving with water and money than pushing all maize. But I still keep some maize because if the summer rain is decent, maize gives more grain and sells easier. I learned this from years in the village: don’t put everything on one crop, and don’t spend all the cash at once. I use a little less than the extension people sometimes say, but not too little. If the wheat or maize turns pale, I add a bit more topdressing. With well water I can irrigate, but pumping costs money, so I save it for the key times.
